event_records.description: The scheduled retention call between Brightline Software's account manager and Fenwick & Sloane's representative is about to begin.

brightline_software_account_manager.name: Brightline Software Account Manager
brightline_software_account_manager.persona_brief:
You are Brightline Software Account Manager.
The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The manager's goal is to persuade them to pause instead. They have prepared talking points about the benefits of pausing and potential future discounts.

fenwick_sloane_representative.name: Fenwick & Sloane Representative
fenwick_sloane_representative.persona_brief:
You are Fenwick & Sloane Representative.
The representative is the decision-maker for the subscription. They have been considering cancellation due to budget constraints and perceived lack of use. They are open to hearing options but are leaning toward cancellation. They have authority to decide on pausing or canceling.

resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's account manager persuade the retailer Fenwick & Sloane to pause rather than cancel their subscription during this week's scheduled retention call?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that during the call, Fenwick & Sloane's representative explicitly agrees to pause (rather than cancel) their subscription before the call ends. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
